description_en: Performs a health check on a replication task during data migration
description_zh: 在数据迁移过程中，用于复制链路健康检查
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-rpl-inspection-task --slink-task-id etx-szr2rr6i00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRplInspectionTask

parameters.help_en: The region ID. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The username used to connect to the source instance (source database)
parameters.help_zh: 源实例（源数据库）的连接用户名
parameters.name: src_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including the password
parameters.help_zh: 源rds实例的用户密码。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括用户密码
parameters.name: src_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB RDS instance to which the migration object belongs in the target instance. > You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all ApsaraDB RDS instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例中迁移对象所属的rds实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有rds实例的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: dst_db

parameters.help_en: The username used to connect to the target instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例的连接用户名
parameters.name: dst_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the privileged user for the destination ApsaraDB RDS instance. > * The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length. * The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. * Special characters include ! @ # $ & % ^ * ( ) _ + - =
parameters.help_zh: 目标rds实例高权限账号的密码。>长度为8~32个字符。由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。特殊字符为!@#$&%^()_+-=
parameters.name: dst_password

Message.description_en: The error message of the task. > This parameter is returned only when the task status is stop
Message.description_zh: 任务错误信息。>仅当任务状态为stop时返回该参数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
